Mctt.Frontend.Parser


From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.PeanoNat String.

From Mctt Require Import Syntax.

Parameter loc : Type.

Fold a reversed parameter telescope into a binder chain. params accumulates left-recursively, so fold_left restores declaration order.
Definition fold_params (b : string -> Cst.obj -> Cst.obj -> Cst.obj)
                       (ps : list (string * Cst.obj)) (body : Cst.obj) : Cst.obj :=
  List.fold_left (fun acc p => b (fst p) (snd p) acc) ps body.

A dotted path as a list, in order.
Definition path_list (p : string * list string) : list string := List.rev (fst p :: snd p).

  end.

Definition nonterminal_semantic_type (nt:nonterminal) : Type:=
  match nt with
  | upath'nt => (list string)%type
  | qpath'nt => ((list string * list string)%type)%type
  | prog'nt => (Cst.prog)%type
  | path'nt => ((string * list string)%type)%type
  | params_opt'nt => (list (string * Cst.obj))%type

  | mods'nt => (Cst.mods)%type
  | mdef'nt => (Cst.mdef)%type
  | mdecl'nt => ((list (string * Cst.obj) * Cst.mdef)%type)%type
  | let_defns'nt => (list Cst.decl)%type
  | let_defn'nt => (Cst.decl)%type
  | leads'nt => (list Cst.cmd)%type
  | lead_cmd'nt => (list Cst.cmd)%type
  | items'nt => (list (string * string))%type
  | item'nt => (string * string)%type
  | import_cmd'nt => (list Cst.cmd)%type
  | ilists'nt => (list iitem)%type
  | ilist'nt => (list iitem)%type
  | iargs'nt => (list Cst.obj)%type
  | fpath'nt => (list string)%type
  | fnbinder'nt => (string -> Cst.obj -> Cst.obj -> Cst.obj)%type
  | dkw'nt => (Cst.dkw)%type
  | cmds'nt => (list Cst.cmd)%type
  | cmd'nt => (list Cst.cmd)%type
  | atomic_obj'nt => (Cst.obj)%type
  | as_opt'nt => (option string)%type
  | app_obj'nt => (Cst.obj)%type
  end.

Definition symbol_semantic_type (s:symbol) : Type:=
  match s with
  | T t => terminal_semantic_type t
  | NT nt => nonterminal_semantic_type nt
  end.

Definition prod_lhs (p:production) :=
  fst (projT1 (prod_contents p)).
Definition prod_rhs_rev (p:production) :=
  snd (projT1 (prod_contents p)).
Definition prod_action (p:production) :=
  projT2 (prod_contents p).

Definition nullable_nterm (nt:nonterminal) : bool :=
  match nt with
  | upath'nt => false
  | qpath'nt => false
  | prog'nt => false
  | path'nt => false
  | params_opt'nt => true
  | params'nt => false
  | param'nt => false
  | open_cmd'nt => false
  | obj'nt => false
  | mpath_opt'nt => true
  | mods'nt => true
  | mdef'nt => false
  | mdecl'nt => false
  | let_defns'nt => false
  | let_defn'nt => false
  | leads'nt => true
  | lead_cmd'nt => false
  | items'nt => false
  | item'nt => false
  | import_cmd'nt => false
  | ilists'nt => true
  | ilist'nt => false
  | iargs'nt => true
  | fpath'nt => false
  | fnbinder'nt => false
  | dkw'nt => false
  | cmds'nt => true
  | cmd'nt => false
  | atomic_obj'nt => false
  | as_opt'nt => true
  | app_obj'nt => false
  end.

Definition first_nterm (nt:nonterminal) : list terminal :=
  match nt with
  | upath'nt => [VAR't]%list
  | qpath'nt => [VAR't]%list
  | prog'nt => [OPEN't; MODULE't; IMPORT't]%list
  | path'nt => [VAR't]%list
  | params_opt'nt => [LPAREN't]%list
  | params'nt => [LPAREN't]%list
  | param'nt => [LPAREN't]%list
  | open_cmd'nt => [OPEN't]%list
  | obj'nt => [ZERO't; VAR't; TYPE't; TRUE_TY't; TRUE't; SUCC't; REC't; PI't; NAT't; LPAREN't; LET't; LAMBDA't; INT't; FALSE_TY't; EXFALSO't]%list
  | mpath_opt'nt => [DOT't]%list
  | mods'nt => [PRIVATE't; ABSTRACT't]%list
  | mdef'nt => [WHERE't; EQ't]%list
  | mdecl'nt => [WHERE't; LPAREN't; EQ't]%list

Module MenhirLibParser := MenhirLib.Main.Make Aut.
Theorem safe:
  MenhirLibParser.safe_validator tt = true.
Proof. exact (eq_refl true<:MenhirLibParser.safe_validator tt = true). Qed.

Theorem complete:
  MenhirLibParser.complete_validator tt = true.
Proof. exact (eq_refl true<:MenhirLibParser.complete_validator tt = true). Qed.

Definition prog : nat -> MenhirLibParser.Inter.buffer -> MenhirLibParser.Inter.parse_result (Cst.prog)%type := MenhirLibParser.parse safe Aut.Init'0.

Theorem prog_correct (log_fuel : nat) (buffer : MenhirLibParser.Inter.buffer):
  match prog log_fuel buffer with
  | MenhirLibParser.Inter.Parsed_pr sem buffer_new =>
      exists word (tree : Gram.parse_tree (NT prog'nt) word),
        buffer = MenhirLibParser.Inter.app_buf word buffer_new /\
        Gram.pt_sem tree = sem
  | _ => True
  end.
Proof. apply MenhirLibParser.parse_correct with (init:=Aut.Init'0). Qed.

Theorem prog_complete (log_fuel : nat) (word : list token) (buffer_end : MenhirLibParser.Inter.buffer) :
  forall tree : Gram.parse_tree (NT prog'nt) word,
  match prog log_fuel (MenhirLibParser.Inter.app_buf word buffer_end) with
  | MenhirLibParser.Inter.Fail_pr => False
  | MenhirLibParser.Inter.Parsed_pr output_res buffer_end_res =>
      output_res = Gram.pt_sem tree /\
      buffer_end_res = buffer_end /\ (Gram.pt_size tree <= PeanoNat.Nat.pow 2 log_fuel)%nat
  | MenhirLibParser.Inter.Timeout_pr => (PeanoNat.Nat.pow 2 log_fuel < Gram.pt_size tree)%nat
  end.
Proof. apply MenhirLibParser.parse_complete with (init:=Aut.Init'0); exact complete. Qed.
